title: sbom-tool vulnerabilitiesSource file
description: Shape of each file referenced by the sbom-tool@1 task's `vulnerabilitiesSource` input. Mirrors `IExternalVulnerability` in shared/ghsa/models/externalVulnerability.ts -- keep both in sync if you change one. See docs/wiki/Task-Reference.md#vulnerabilitiessource-format for the full write-up.

packageName.description: Name of the affected package. Matched case-insensitively against the SBOM package's `name` field. No purl/ecosystem matching is performed, so this must match the SBOM's own package name exactly (e.g. the bare npm package name, or the NuGet package id).

packageVersion.description: Affected package version, matched exactly against the SBOM package's `versionInfo`. If omitted, the vulnerability is applied to every SBOM package matching `packageName`, regardless of version.

id.description: Advisory identifier: a GHSA id (e.g. "GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx"), a CVE id, or any other identifier string from your scanner. Used to derive a fallback advisory URL when `url` is omitted.

cveId.description: CVE identifier, if `id` above isn't already a CVE id. Also used to derive a fallback advisory URL (NVD) when `url` is omitted.

summary.description: One-line title, shown in the report tab's advisory list and as part of the human-readable external reference comment.

description.description: Longer free-text description, shown in the report tab's advisory detail view.

url.description: Link to the advisory page. If omitted, a best-effort link is derived from `cveId` (NVD) or a `GHSA-*` `id` (GitHub Advisories); if neither is available, a synthetic `urn:vulnerability:...` identifier is used instead so the entry still dedupes correctly in the report tab.

vulnerableVersionRange.description: Human-readable affected version range, e.g. "<=1.8.4" or "20.0.0-next.0 - 20.3.26". Not parsed/validated -- shown as-is in the report tab.

fixedVersion.description: First version that fixes the vulnerability, if known.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the advisory was published.

severity.description: Must match one of these values exactly (case-sensitive) -- mirrors SecurityAdvisorySeverity in shared/ghsa/models/securityAdvisory.ts.
